prompt: Why was life expectancy at birth so low in the Middle Ages?

options.text: Because adults died of old age at 30
Because births were hardly ever recorded

explanation: About half of all children died, and those deaths dragged the average down.
misconception: An average of 30 doesn’t mean people grew old and died at 30.

prompt: According to landholder records, to about what age did a medieval English 25-year-old live, on average?
explanation: He had, on average, another 23 to 26 years to live, reaching about 50.

prompt: What share of medieval English noblemen lived past 70?
explanation: Half died before 50 and only 11% passed 70: old age was possible, but less common than today.
